pre_condition: usd is None or a numeric value representing a cost in USD.
post_condition: If usd is None, returns the placeholder string "—". Otherwise returns a string consisting of a dollar-sign prefix "$" immediately followed by the value formatted with decimal precision that decreases as the absolute magnitude increases: three decimal places when |usd| < 1, two decimal places when |usd| < 100, one decimal place when |usd| < 10000, and zero decimal places when |usd| ≥ 10000. The returned string is a valid USD cost representation.
